steps.text: Assassin's Creed is a 32-bit game whose x87 maths runs slowly under Rosetta: the title screen stuttered at about 7 fps. This asks for a Wine 11 engine, which ships athei's x87sidecar, turns the sidecar on for this game with HB_X87SIDECAR=1 and sets DXVK, since D3DMetal crashed on the way in. Measured by udance4ever on Wine 11 r30 with DXVK on an M1: snappy at about 40 fps (highball-db#901, 2026-11-06). Choose the controller in the game's settings at every start.
